description: P6 field-mapping C[information-card] / J[card]: component-internal typography parameters for an information card instance. These belong to the component definition's parameter interface, NOT page Layout (D4). Width mode and limit are one contract (M14+M26): fixed uses limit as the width; fit-content-up-to-limit measures content width up to limit, never silently shrinking font or dropping fields. sections.gap is the FULL title/body section gap (M18: baseline = 2 x old line_gap), divider at its midpoint. title.wrap_mode is explicit (M24): single-line-reject-overflow refuses overflow; a wrap mode must be declared by the component. Closed: unknown parameters rejected; no open extension bag.

structure.description: P6 X05: the registered card internal-structure preset (declared, not an implicit renderer convention). section_order is the painted order; divider_position locates the body/title divider; empty_body is the single-line label behavior. The baseline preset is body-divider-title with the divider at the section-gap midpoint and centered empty-body labels. A different structure is a new explicit design choice.
